scheme_name: Immediate Assistance for Severe Injury in Road/Fire Accident (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑serviceman or the widow of an Ex‑serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Applicant must have suffered a severe injury in a road or fire accident
Applicant must not be a member of the Ex‑Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 transferred to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
